verdict.rationale: AMD explicitly documents its AM5 socket with a multi-year, multi-generation support commitment, directly matching the story ('the only processor manufacturer committed to multi-year socket support... upgrade to next-gen performance tomorrow'). Community reviews corroborate the platform's longevity via socket-compatible generational releases (9950X3D fitting into existing AM5 boards). Missing for 10: independent long-term verification of actual multi-gen upgrades across specific motherboard chipsets, and explicit BIOS/board compatibility details.
